items.title: What Could Humana (HUM) Cancer Care Model Mean For Patients And Costs?
items.summary: Humana (NYSE:HUM) has launched a new cancer care model in partnership with Evolent Health and American Oncology Network. The collaboration focuses on reducing prior authorization barriers for oncology treatments to streamline access for eligible Humana members. The care model uses real time analytics to help oncologists tailor treatment plans and align provider incentives around measured outcomes and costs. items.title: UnitedHealth Sinks 18% in a Week on Washington’s Medicare Advantage Crackdown. Is It “Number One on Sale”?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUnitedHealth fell 18% in a week after CMS proposed tougher Medicare Advantage audits and a star-ratings overhaul it says would cut payments by about $107 billion through 2037. Humana and CVS Health fell on the same proposals, and Humana is the most exposed.

items.title: Not Good: Medicare Proposes $107 Billion in Bonus Cuts. That’s a Big Risk for UnitedHealth and Humana
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUnitedHealth fell 1% today after CMS proposed star-ratings changes it estimates would cut Medicare Advantage bonuses by about $107 billion between 2031 and 2037. Humana has the most at stake, because its expected earnings rebound in 2027 depends on recovering from this year’s star-ratings hit.
